newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's ARD to launch digital TV decoder.
newsitem.headline: Germany's ARD to launch digital TV decoder.

text.p: Germany's ARD public television channel said on Sunday it would launch its own decoder for digital television in competition with the Kirch group's unit launched over the summer.
ARD, a member of the MMBG consortium competing with Kirch which was badly undermined by the recent pullout of Deutsche Telekom, said it would market its own decoder instead.
ARD chief executive Albert Scharf told West German Radio that the decoder would be available next April for a price of around 200 marks -- far cheaper than the Kirch group decoder.
